subject: game-production-runner graceful interruption checkpoints and cache references

claims.pass_condition: A graceful interruption appends one sealed checkpoint bound to the exact current step-ledger position and returns no terminal receipt.
claims.counterevidence: Missing file, terminal receipt present, wrong count/tail, or non-false authority.
claims.observed_evidence: Game and portable interrupted runs return axm.production-run-checkpoint/v1 with matching count, tail, verified receipts, and false authority.

claims.pass_condition: Repeated interruptions extend one checkpoint digest chain without rolling back any prior ledger prefix.
claims.counterevidence: Broken previous digest, lower ledger count, removed verified prefix, or checkpoint/step-ledger mismatch.
claims.observed_evidence: Two portable checkpoints preserve the first verified prefix; a validly resealed rollback is refused.

claims.pass_condition: Valid checkpoint history and pre-checkpoint legacy interruption both resume without duplicating step evidence; tampered history blocks.
claims.counterevidence: Receipt duplication, schema mixing, legacy rejection, or tampered checkpoint accepted.
claims.observed_evidence: Game, neutral portable, repeated, legacy-without-checkpoint, and tampered-checkpoint resume assertions cover the route.

claims.pass_condition: Only the latest checkpoint matching the whole current ledger can grant cache-reference protection.
claims.counterevidence: Mutable state alone, stale tail, uncheckpointed append, tamper, truncation, or earlier checkpoint accepted.
claims.observed_evidence: Game and portable checkpoint sets complete; every stale, missing, tampered, truncated, or mismatched anchor is REVIEW_REQUIRED with protection false.

claims.pass_condition: A present invalid terminal receipt cannot fall back to an older valid checkpoint.
claims.counterevidence: Discovery status COMPLETE using checkpoint evidence after terminal validation fails.
claims.observed_evidence: The fixture returns REVIEW_REQUIRED with REFERENCE_RUN_RECEIPT_SHAPE_INVALID.

claims.pass_condition: Checkpoint scanning has explicit independent count and byte ceilings and runs only on explicit discovery or retention application.
claims.primary_surface: runtime scan budgets and limit assertions
claims.counterevidence: Unbounded checkpoint file/root enumeration or candidate-run scan.
claims.observed_evidence: Per-run 10000/16 MiB and aggregate 100000/64 MiB ceilings are enforced; explicit low ceilings produce LIMIT_EXCEEDED.

claims.pass_condition: An exact checkpoint-derived key and entry digest is protected by planning and rechecked before deletion.
claims.primary_surface: retention plan fixture plus existing apply-time reference freshness suite
claims.counterevidence: Referenced key becomes a candidate, entry mismatch applies, or changed reference snapshot deletes.
claims.observed_evidence: Checkpoint binding is protected with no mismatch; existing fresh-rescan race tests remain green.

claims.pass_condition: Derived checkpoint reference sets contain no local path or private run identifier.
claims.primary_surface: serialized reference-set assertions in shared and CLI self-tests
claims.counterevidence: Drive path, local run directory, or run id appears in the derived set.
claims.observed_evidence: Both shared and CLI checkpoint-derived sets pass path and run-id absence checks.
